"import openpyxl
from openpyxl import load_workbook

# Load the input workbook
wb = load_workbook('input.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Read source data from columns A:J (excluding K:V which has manual transpose)
# Source is 11 rows × 9 cols to transpose to 9 rows × 11 cols (K2:U10)
source_data = []
for row_idx in range(2, 13):  # rows 2-12 (11 rows)
    row_data = []
    for col_idx in range(1, 10):  # columns A-I (9 columns)
        row_data.append(ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=col_idx).value)
    source_data.append(row_data)

# Transpose: swap rows and columns (11×9 -> 9×11)
transposed = list(map(list, zip(*source_data)))

# Clear existing data in K2:U10
for row_idx in range(2, 11):
    for col_idx in range(11, 22):  # K=11 to U=21
        ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=col_idx).value = None

# Write transposed data to K2:U10 maintaining position correspondence
for i in range(9):
    for j in range(11):
        if i < len(transposed) and j < len(transposed[i]):
            ws.cell(row=2+i, column=11+j).value = transposed[i][j]

# Save as output.xlsx
wb.save('output.xlsx')"
